# Entry point the engine-only helper imports. Engines with their own

raise ArgumentError, "No engine registered as #{name.inspect}. Registered: #{registry.keys.inspect}"
# Dev only: drop the cached map when the engine's importmap file or JS changes.
def initialize(engines, app: nil, gem_paths: Gem.path, cwd: Dir.pwd, all: false)
# The target containing the current directory, if any.
Target.new(name: name, root: Pathname.new(engine.root.to_s), namespace: namespace, host: host)
# Failsafe file edits for generators. Order of preference:
#   1. safe_inject  - add a line next to an anchor (no backup needed)
#   2. safe_replace - change existing text (writes a .backup first)
#   3. safe_rewrite - replace a whole file (writes a .backup first)
# Every method returns true if it changed something, false if not.
def safe_inject(path, text, after: nil, before: nil)
return manual(path, text, "file not found", :red) unless File.exist?(file)
return manual(path, text, "anchor not found", :yellow) unless found
return manual(path, replacement, "file not found", :red) unless File.exist?(file)
return manual(path, replacement, "pattern not found", :yellow) unless content.match?(pattern)
# Never overwrites an existing backup: file.backup, file.backup.1, ...
# One "identical" line per file per run, however many steps inspect it.
# For steps that can't even be attempted (no file to edit).
# Precompiled manifest first (the source tree may be absent in production),
# then the asset search paths. Sprockets resolves and digests the names itself.
desc "Set up engine asset helpers (stylesheets and importmap) in an engine."
class_option :engine, type: :string, desc: "Engine name (skips the prompt)"
class_option :importmap, type: :string, default: "merge", enum: %w[merge own both],
desc: "merge into host importmap, own independent map, or both"
class_option :stimulus, type: :string, default: "host", enum: %w[host own none],
desc: "host Stimulus app, engine's own Stimulus app, or no controllers"
class_option :all, type: :boolean, default: false, desc: "Also list engines from installed gems"
picker = EnginePicker.new(candidates, app: app, all: options[:all])
raise Thor::Error, "No engine named #{options[:engine].inspect}. Try --all." unless @target
say "Host apps need no setup: engines merge into your importmap automatically.", :yellow if host?
return manual("lib/<engine>/engine.rb", configure_line, "engine class not found", :yellow) unless file
return needs_manual("no gemspec found (add `spec.add_dependency \"eng_assets\"` by hand)") unless spec
return needs_manual("no layout found (add the engine_stylesheet_link_tags and importmap helpers by hand)") unless layout
# Must stay the last public method: Rails runs public methods in order.
say "\n#{@manual_steps} step(s) need a manual edit (see the 'manual' lines above).", :yellow
say "\nEverything is already set up. Nothing left to do, please proceed.", :green
say "\nInstall complete. Backups (if any) are saved as *.backup next to the edited files.", :green
